reuse.why: Uses the existing db helpers and adds a single guard; the tree had no existing link guard or shared link sequence to reuse.

duplication.why: The rule is defined once; only its call is repeated in each of the five pre-existing provider link functions.

placement.why: The guard lives in accounts/app.ts beside the link functions and runs before any bank lookup or write.

scope.why: Only the guard, its five call sites and a release note.

maintainability.why: Clear, single-query guard; a future provider must remember to call it because the link sequence itself is not shared.

one_place.where: assertBankAccountNotLinked in server/accounts/app.ts, called first by all five link*Account functions (GoCardless, SimpleFin, Pluggy.ai, Akahu, Enable Banking).
